name: Venkatesh Sarvasiddhi, Ph.D.
text:

Most product managers come from tech backgrounds and learn operations on the job. Ashutosh did it backwards. He understood stakeholder management, cross-functional coordination, and high-stakes decision-making before he ever touched a SaaS roadmap.

Then came Indian Institute of Management Bangalore's one-year MBA in 2022. The inflection point. He took everything he learned in steel operations and applied it to product strategy. Persistent Systems gave him his first product role, building scalable SaaS solutions. Avalara let him drive the EMEA VAT portfolio, turning complex compliance needs into intuitive products that global enterprises actually want to use.

Now at Ceipal, he's scaling talent technology solutions. HR tech. Compliance platforms. Product ecosystems that need someone who understands both the technical build and the operational reality of how these systems get used in high-pressure environments.

Steel plant planning taught him to think in systems. SaaS taught him to think in user journeys. The combination is rare.

He's also mentoring aspiring product managers and invested in Huemn.ai, an AI portfolio tool for creatives. The operational guy who became the product guy who's now helping build the next wave of tech talent.

name: Sarika Bhatt
text:

Sarika Bhatt just took on the Group Head - Human Resources role at Novasol Ingredients Pvt. Ltd., and her career shows she's fluent in multiple industrial languages.

Telecom at Ishan Technologies. Agrochemicals at GSP Crop Science Ltd. Steel at VMS TMT PRIVATE LIMITED. Plastics at Texel Industries Ltd.. Electronics at Nextray Technologies. Each sector has its own rhythm. Manufacturing floors operate differently than corporate offices. Compliance frameworks shift. Safety protocols change. Talent expectations vary.

Most HR leaders build depth in one industry. Sarika built range across five.

Novasol Ingredients Pvt Limited isn't a straightforward business either. They're a 20+ year player in specialty food ingredients, exporting and distributing everything from hydro-colloids and emulsifiers to natural fibers, preservatives, and coco products. Their customers span confectionery, bakery, dairy, processed food, pharma, poultry, and cattle feed. That's not one talent strategy. That's multiple workforce ecosystems under one roof.
